notes: «سفيان، وأبي، وإسرائيل، عن أبي إسحاق»: three co-transmitters at one level; «أبي» is the transmitter's father, a bare relation.
Asim asked Ali («سألنا عليا») and relays his answer («قال علي فتلك ست عشرة ركعة»), so Ali is the last link (rule 5, 6).
«زاد فيه أبي» names the same father already in the chain, so it is not a new route; «حبيب بن أبي ثابت» speaks in the scene and is not a link.
